descriptionEn: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and devour a Corpse or Cullable enemy, and additional nearby Corpses. For each enemy or corpse devoured, you regenerate life and gain a Power Charge. If the target is far enough away, you will leap to them and damage nearby enemies where you land. Targeting nearby enemies or corpses will not perform a leap or a Slam.
summaryPt: Vira Wyvern e devora cadáveres (ou inimigo executável) — cada um dá vida e 1 Power Charge. Se o alvo estiver longe, salta até ele.
wherePt: Uncut Skill Gem (nível 5+). Precisa de talismã (forma de Wyvern).
